docs.summary: Handle to work recorded through GraphicsDevice.Record. Wait on it or drop it, the work runs either way.
True once the GPU finished the work.

members.name: Wait
members.signature: public abstract bool Wait(ulong nanosecondTimeout = ulong.MaxValue)

docs.summary: Blocks until the GPU finishes the work, or until timeout.
docs.returns: True if it finished before timeout.

params.nanosecondTimeout: Max wait in ns. ulong.MaxValue = no timeout.
